description: This file defines the main application component for a Next.js frontend, handling user interactions for uploading documents, managing persona draft/candidate states, editing persona details, and rendering various UI states accordingly. It integrates with an API client to handle document uploads, orchestrations, and finalization of persona artifacts.

methods.name: mapDraftToPersonaData
methods.description: Transforms draft persona data into a format suitable for rendering or further processing.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Validates the uploaded file for type, size, or other criteria before processing.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles the event when a user changes the uploaded file input.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds newly selected files to the upload queue or state.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped into a drag-and-drop area.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Handles the drag-over event to enable dropping files.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specified file from the upload list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers the generation of a persona draft based on current data.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves changes made to the persona data.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona creation process and final artifacts.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona's skill list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skill list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the profile image uploaded by the user.
